    nodes.list read

    GET /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/nodes MCP nodes_list

    List nodes

    Cards on a chart (entities, people, areas, notes). Filter by type, or by q (name contains).

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    chartstringrequiredChart id, or "active" for the chart open in the app.
    typeenumOne of entity, person, area, note.
    qstring
    limitintegerPage size (1-200, default 50).
    cursorstringnextCursor from the previous page.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "chart": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Chart id, or \"active\" for the chart open in the app."
    },
    "type": {
      "enum": [
        "entity",
        "person",
        "area",
        "note"
      ]
    },
    "q": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200
    },
    "limit": {
      "type": "integer",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 200,
      "default": 50,
      "description": "Page size (1-200, default 50)."
    },
    "cursor": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "nextCursor from the previous page."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env",
    "chart"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    Output

    FieldTypeDescription
    itemsobject[]required
    items[].idstringrequired
    items[].namestringrequired
    items[].typeenumrequiredOne of entity, person, area, note.
    items[].xnumberrequired
    items[].ynumberrequired
    items[].wnumber
    items[].hnumber
    items[].notesstring
    nextCursorstring | nullrequired
    revintegerrequiredWorkspace revision after (or at) this call.
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "items": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "id": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "name": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "type": {
            "enum": [
              "entity",
              "person",
              "area",
              "note"
            ]
          },
          "x": {
            "type": "number"
          },
          "y": {
            "type": "number"
          },
          "w": {
            "type": "number"
          },
          "h": {
            "type": "number"
          },
          "notes": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        },
        "required": [
          "id",
          "name",
          "type",
          "x",
          "y"
        ]
      }
    },
    "nextCursor": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ]
    },
    "rev": {
      "type": "integer",
      "description": "Workspace revision after (or at) this call."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "items",
    "nextCursor",
    "rev"
  ]
}

    Example: People on the active chart

    curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/charts/active/nodes?type=person" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
    {
  "items": [
    {
      "id": "cleo",
      "name": "Cleo Park",
      "type": "person",
      "x": 320,
      "y": 144,
      "notes": ""
    }
  ],
  "nextCursor": null,
  "rev": 42
}

    Example: Kestrel Group

    curl -sS -X GET "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/charts/active/nodes/flygon" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY"
    {
  "rev": 42,
  "node": {
    "id": "flygon",
    "name": "Kestrel Group",
    "type": "entity",
    "x": 400,
    "y": 0,
    "notes": ""
  }

    nodes.create write

    POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/nodes MCP nodes_create

    Create a node

    Add a card to a chart. Without x/y it is placed at the origin, stepping 32px diagonally past occupied spots (as the app does).

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    chartstringrequiredChart id, or "active" for the chart open in the app.
    typeenumrequiredOne of entity, person, area, note.
    namestringrequired
    notesstring
    wnumber
    hnumber
    xnumber
    ynumber
    JSON Schema
    {
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "env": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[A-Za-z0-9-]{1,64}$",
      "description": "Environment id (see envs.list)."
    },
    "chart": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200,
      "description": "Chart id, or \"active\" for the chart open in the app."
    },
    "type": {
      "enum": [
        "entity",
        "person",
        "area",
        "note"
      ]
    },
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "minLength": 1,
      "maxLength": 200
    },
    "notes": {
      "type": "string",
      "maxLength": 4000
    },
    "w": {
      "type": "number",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 5000
    },
    "h": {
      "type": "number",
      "minimum": 1,
      "maximum": 5000
    },
    "x": {
      "type": "number"
    },
    "y": {
      "type": "number"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "env",
    "chart",
    "type",
    "name"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}

    Output

    FieldTypeDescription
    revintegerrequiredWorkspace revision after (or at) this call.

    node.idstringrequired
    node.namestringrequired

    node.wnumber

    node.notesstring
    JSON Schema

  "type": "object",
  "properties": {

    },

    Example: Add a person

    curl -sS -X POST "$FLOW_URL/api/v1/envs/default-workspace/charts/active/nodes" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"type":"person","name":"Cleo Park","x":320,"y":144}'
    {
  "rev": 43,
  "node": {
    "id": "cleo",
    "name": "Cleo Park",
    "type": "person",
    "x": 320,
    "y": 144,
    "notes": ""
  }
}

    nodes.update write

    PATCH /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/nodes/{node} MCP nodes_update

    nodes.move write

    POST /api/v1/envs/{env}/charts/{chart}/nodes/{node}/move MCP nodes_move

    Move a node

    Set a chart card's position (canvas pixels; the app snaps to a 16px grid when dragging, the API does not).

    Input

    FieldTypeDescription
    envstringrequiredEnvironment id (see envs.list).
    chartstringrequiredChart id, or "active" for the chart open in the app.
    nodestringrequiredNode id.
    xnumberrequired
    ynumberrequired
    JSON Schema

  "type": "object",

    Example: Move

  -H "Authorization: Bearer $FLOW_API_KEY" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"x":400,"y":0}'
    {
  "rev": 44,
  "node": {
    "id": "flygon",
